name: kb-writer
description: Create KB Writer intent workspaces from completed local sessions, with PM-reviewed completion envelopes.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a finished local session into a reviewed KB intent workspace.
interface.longDescription: KB Writer reduces a completed local coding session into a PM-reviewed completion envelope, creates a durable intent workspace, and lets the PM drive planning, target selection, drafting, review, and publication through the KB Writer backend.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a KB intent from this session.
